title: Cayde’s Death — Transcript

lines.text: by DrJazzyBebop
Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Zavala.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I thought you'd be gone by now. I would attempt to dissuade you from your course, but it would only… insult us both. As it stands, we've got every available Guardian dealing with escapees from the Prison of Elders. It's still not enough. If you go to war with the Reef, it's a war you will have to fight alone. The Vanguard cannot help you.
The Guardian speaks to Banshee-44.

lines.speaker: Banshee-44
lines.text: Memory ain't so good these days. But Cayde… Never forget Cayde. Hunter through and through. Left all his worldly possessions to whoever finally took him down. Don't know about you. But. Rather lose every last memory in my head than know that little prince holds Cayde's prized cannon: the Ace of Spades. You gotta promise me. Put Uldren in the ground. And get the Ace of Spades back. If anyone should have the Ace… S'you.
Bazaar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Ikora.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: On the edge of the Reef lies a wasteland called the Tangled Shore. That's where you'll find Uldren. I won't stop you from going. As for Zavala… He would cling to the broken pieces of the future he imagined until they crumble in his hand. He hasn't seen what I've seen. Ever since the Traveler woke, it's been speaking to me. Visions of crowns, roses, silver trees. Candles that turn into bonfires. And I'm not the only one. If you see something… new… don't be afraid to pursue it. I wish I could help you more. But the City needs a unified Vanguard. Or at least the illusion of one. And… this is your road, now.
The Guardian speaks to the Drifter.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I can't tell if that look in your eye is determination… or rage. Word is, you and Cayde had a pretty good partnership. That's rare. From what I could tell, that guy preferred to work alone. Maybe he liked how you pulped a Hive god or two. I know that's why I like ya. Listen, don't let his death weigh on you. Somewhere out there, someone's got a bullet with your name on it. Same for him. Same for me. Nothin' we can do. So go out on your terms with a gun in your hand and loot in your pockets. Haha! Only way to live. The Derelict's always in orbit if you wanna… vent.
Hangar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Amanda Holliday.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: I was born outside the City walls, you know that? Yeah, it was rough on the refugee roads. My ma died crossing the Panama ravine. Pa died just a half-day's ride from the City gate. Folks back then thought, if you made it to the City, you were safe. Took me a long time to feel safe here. I guess that's why I like working in the Tower with y'all. Guardians don't die. 'Least, that's what I thought. But… Forward momentum, buddy. That's what Cayde would want. And, uh… what else can we do?
Trostland, European Dead Zone
The Guardian speaks to Devrim Kay.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: I've always had a… morbid curiosity about how Guardians process death - the kind you don't return from. Then I saw the faces of those mourning Cayde. The Farm practically came to a standstill. The old boy charmed the pants off the place, and it showed. Death binds us all together, whoever we are - Guardians and non-Guardians alike. Now, what say we pour one out for our old friend, eh?
Siren's Watch, Titan
The Guardian speaks to Sloane.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Zavala wasn't thrilled about you running off after Cayde's killers. Can't say I blame him… Just tell me you got 'em. What? Even I know duty and obligation don't always line up. That's why I like you, Guardian. You don't just deal in justice, you embody it. Keep up the good fight. I'm rooting for you.
Exodus Black, Nessus
The Guardian speaks to Failsafe.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain! I received word of the Cayde unit's life status. Donezo. Please let me know if there is anything I can do to accelerate and conclude your grief process. 'Cause I'm fine. Anecdote! As the AI of Exodus Black, I experienced the death of every single one of my crew members! I hypothesized that the more losses one has suffered, the easier subsequent losses become! Field research has proven my hypothesis false! Losing Cayde makes me feel… f-f-feel… f-f-f-feel… AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH - I feel terrible!
The Rupture, Io
The Guardian speaks to Asher Mir.

lines.speaker: Asher Mir
lines.text: When I entered the Pyramidion, I was led astray by curiosity and self-interest. I now pay an expeditiously advancing price. Comparable, regrettably, to how Cayde's pride accosted him in the depths of that atrocious prison. As I understand it, retribution has had its claws in you. Bear in mind, assistant, try as you might, there's no circumventing the price.

lines.text: by Eruke & Sekuiya
Lost Oasis/The Rupture, Echo Mesa, Io
The Guardian deploys a containment bank underneath a Pyramid Scale and joins other Guardians to charge the Seed of Silver Wings with Darkness.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You did well to find this point of infestation.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, but something's not right here.

lines.text: The Darkness changes its environment as the Traveler did.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sounds peachy.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You are our hand in the field, Guardian. Charge the Seed so that we may interpret the Darkness' intentions.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Seed's corruption is a necessity, and a deed better left in noble hands. See it done.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: First plundered by Cabal, now beset with the rot of Darkness. Even the purity once endowed by the Traveler wavers.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Do you sense the gravity here, Guardian? A sullen pit that sinks to spoil. The Pyramids bring entropy, and we will restore order.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The great game is in motion. Charge the Seed so that we may commune once more with the Dark.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Pyramid reaches out. Contain it!
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Time to be good guys. Dark up, kick in some teeth, and bank those Motes! WOO!
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I know you're curious to hear what they have to say… but remember what they've done. Be careful.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: A whole lotta incoming. Hey, Moondust, you got anything for this?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They seek strength, as we do. Though they lack the constitution to control it.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Constitution. I like the way you talk.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Vanguard tussled with this on the Moon, right? Should be easy.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This is different. The Nightmares were simply an interpretation. What we have before us is the source, directly viewed, and not to be underestimated.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Ah, that Seed's bringing in all sorts of funk. Bogeys. Inbound!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We cannot lose this position, Guardian. Savathûn's clutches tighten if we hesitate.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank down! Ring that dinner bell. Stretch. Soup's on!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Io is a sacred place, not a slop hall for haggard buzzards.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: World's just bones on bones. Been like that forever.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Pyramid's going nuts. This is the hotspot, that's for sure. Bank down!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian, you are not alone. Our foes seek to claim power from the Darkness.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bring 'em down and bank those Motes!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. Contain the spread of this infestation, and we will utilize what we capture to decipher the Pyramid's intentions.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Showtime! Signals going haywire all around ya.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Darkness tempts our aggressors with promises of power. Are they fodder? An offering to our cause?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Never seen a free meal, and I've been around a long time.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That Pyramid cuts a sinister figure. Too bad your Golden Age basket case couldn't pull the trigger.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Warmind's fall was unsettling. The Darkness would not have approached had Rasputin been a credible threat. We were fools to expect anything less.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Your big blue boss looks rattled, brother. I'd be worried.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Commander Zavala has far more to orchestrate than a back-alley brawl, rat.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: All right. All right. Just…looking out.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank incoming! [shivers] I'm starting to catch a streak of that hero feel.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oh? Is that why you're here? Some noble vocation?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Nah. Just the show, Moondust.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You know the rub. Bank those motes… and snag one for ol' Drifter.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: All right. Your show, Moondust.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So this is the plan. All right… bank down.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If we tap this font of power, others will come to challenge. Collect whatever Darkness they hold.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Hero. Ready for a gunfight?
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Mini-bank in transit. You're up, brother.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Staunch the flow of Darkness, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: And keep 'em off my bank. Paint's barely dry.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank firing in. Kid, you're on deck.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian. Our foes mean to interrupt our work. Cut them down.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Ooh, Moondust, you've got a mean streak. [laughs]
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What do you think your competitors want with all this Darkness?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Power. One last gasp before they fade into obscurity.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Pretty grim.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Invaders, typically, are not afforded pity.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn seeks to disrupt. Work with purpose, before there is nothing left to salvage.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Salvage ain't so bad.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: There's still space on the outskirts, Drifter, should you wish to observe rather than act.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Maybe I'll save you a spot.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian —

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Transmat firing! Watch your limbs.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Good Luck.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The denizens of this world swarm to stake their claims. Show them what comes from their recklessness.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Lady…you are freaky. Drifter like.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Our attempt at alignment has drawn attention.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Understood, Eris. Let's charge up the Seed and get out of here.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Scans are all over the place. I can't get a lock on anything.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn obscures our vision. Fear not the Witch Queen's tricks, Little Light.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I envy you, Eris. You don't have to feel the Darkness tugging at your core.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I feel their hooks…at every moment, Little Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then you know why we have to win.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, we are the final line that halts a second Collapse. Do not falter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You weren't around for the Dark Ages, were you?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've lived long enough to see what happens when good people fail.

lines.text: Guardian, siege preparations are… they're ongoing. What is your status?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'd say we're close to uncovering another message, Commander.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're here to help you, Commander. We carry the weight together.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: As it should be, old friend.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You are both stronger than you know. Be safe. Be vigilant. I await your return.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Free and clear. Nice.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sure is a lot of bluster just to show up and want to chat. Take a tip from your ol' pal, Drifter. When someone's talking, don't watch the mouth. Ya dig?
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: It's no wonder those City chumps talk you up all the time. But we go way back. Might even rattle off a few boasts myself. "Yeah, I know the hero. Came up under ol' Drifter's wing running Gambit!" Ah! Roll's right off the tongue. Probably plays great with a tune.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Pyramid on the Moon was a herald, of that I am sure. Thanks to their efforts, we will soon know more of their message.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Why have they not simply ended it? Do they fear us so little? Or, like the Seed, is our cultivation not yet complete?
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You have moved us forward. And yet, my mind rests on one thought. Why not simply press us at the City? Do they suspect such an act would awaken the Traveler? We must find answers.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Pyramids cast wide shadows. I sometimes find myself adrift in them. Eriana would tell me: a Light can never be lost, for they are the beacons by which others find their way.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It did not take them long to arrive once the Undying Mind was slain. They were close. Bearing witness. Perched along our borders with patient determination…and we did nothing.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well done. Our answer draws ever nearer.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Jovian monarch… its steady presence falters against the Pyramid; pushed away on gentle ripples. Darkness burrows into the cosmic fabric here, emanating distance and entropy. This is not a product of design. It is their nature to divide.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Seed wilts. Do you feel it? See it blench against grander purpose? A cost to all things, Guardian. Debts paid.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We find ourselves one turn closer to an unveiling. The message clarifies, but one page is not enough. We will need volumes.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sharp shooting. You're topped off. Time to scoot.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Return to us when you have intercepted another message. Savathûn cannot deny us forever.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Clean up and move out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well done. Savathûn's hold loosens ever so slightly.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn's incantations break momentarily, but there is still much to uncover. You have done well to empower the Seed, Guardian.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You know… I'm taking odds on how all this shakes out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Under the presumption that you'd survive long enough to pay the dividends?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Heh, Drifter gets by.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Like rats on sinking ships.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hell of a sight out there. Real… something.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Our sorrows are winds and storms, rat. Violent. But passing.

lines.text: Uh, that name gets around.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's a title.

lines.text: To pull the Darkness from our foes… It is not an act I take lightly. We have no other choice but to align the Seed.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hmph. Funny.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Warlords used that line all the time. Dark Age ideas die hard, I guess.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So…what? Is it the eyes? They give you space magic? Pact with the devil?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Why?

lines.text: Small talk. Common curio. Hot gossip is you're wishing on a star. All the rage these days.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The stars whisper your name, Germaine. Truth seeks you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I'm as true as they come.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: And yet, I see only a meretricious rogue.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Don't cuss at me.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.text: Vanguard came to me pretty quick when they couldn't find Osiris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You should have heard the offers I turned down.

lines.text: Is that so? Of all the vaults in the City, none held any value for you?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's the problem with you Guardians. So materialistic.

lines.text: And yet here you are.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Keeping my ear to the ground.

lines.text: I wonder what Saint-14 would do if we unleashed him on the Pyramids. He never did get to face his army of Darkness.

lines.text: Raw deal for the chaff.

lines.text: Inspiring heroics. I'm all riled.

lines.text: I didn't take you as the type to swoon.

lines.text: Kid reminds me of Wei Ning. Nothing wrong with a little white hat every now and then.

lines.text: She was a treasure. You knew her?

lines.text: Had to pay her tab a few times. Cleared me out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She did possess great ambition.

lines.text: I'll speak with him. He's… in a foul mood.

lines.text: His own fault. Never seen a man choose to die slow.

lines.text: He chose to find a way to live.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Nah, just took him a while to realise he's bleeding out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You know a great deal about biding time, don't you?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You and me both, Moondust. Peas in a pod.

lines.text: Uh, Moondust… you ever get a look inside that Pyramid?

lines.text: I know enough to say Asher Mir is wrong.

lines.text: Spill.

lines.text: He theorized several versions of their composition, destructive capabilities, numbers. As terrifying as Asher's theories seemed at the time, he never imagined a scenario in which they came in peace.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Put a gun in a man's hand, he'll start looking for a fight.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: When we decipher the next message, I will inform the Hidden. Together, we will make sense of the Pyramid's arrival.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Want me to run it by ol' Rey Rey?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ikora leads the City in siege preparations. She hasn't time to speak.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Fair enough. Sheepdogs just bark.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Mini-bank's brimmin'. Lay low for a bit, kid. You're starting to draw some heat.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Clearing space in your doomsday shelter already? Aren't you tired of cowering under floorboards, relying on hope and prayers?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: No bother. Right insulation. A good blanket.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Why are you not there now?
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: In and out. This place is tapped. Scrubbing the bank for our next drop.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Quicken your pace, both of you. Soon our prize will be spent, and there are miles to go before we rest.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Something has shifted. Io is not as it was before.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: No kidding. Look in the sky.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's the life that once was. It is pale. Gaunt. In retreat.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sounds like retreat's the right idea.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Lot of maintenance frames sweeping down here.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Our work has produced more foot traffic, more dust, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Feels more like someone spying.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Zavala can… tend towards micromanagement.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How many times do we have to teach you this lesson, Savathûn? We don't give up.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Say, Hero, if you ever get bored of that squawk box, I can hook you up with some new tech.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Does that thing you've made even still have Light?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Enough. Bickering does not serve us.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Got a visitor… again. Hey, Cue Ball, got some time to kill?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I was passing by.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Not checking in on anyone?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Someone special?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Send me your report. Today.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardians fail to secure enough resonate energy and extract the Seed of Silver Wings.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank's getting dinged up. This is a lost cause, Brother. Scoot, and we'll try again when things aren't so hot.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I'm not gonna risk my gear for nothing. Break off and we'll try again later.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's enough for now. We'll come back when things calm down.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Things aren't going our way, pal. I'm calling my gear back before it gets too banged up. Get outta there.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are overwhelmed. Retreat, and we will prepare ourselves better for the next assault.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are not able to win every engagement. There will be another chance, of that I am sure.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Bah! There's no point continuing this attempt. Regroup. There's more battles to come.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We cannot hold this position any longer without risking our work. Take what we have and leave.
// OPTIONAL

lines.text: It's… so… Dark. Get out, before the bank ruptures!

title: Echoed Warnings | Anchored Thrones — Transcript

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: Act I
lines.text: Echoed Warnings

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, the Drifter's recon dredged up some intel.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I'll keep it short. Energy's getting yanked on down from the Dreadnaught into Savathûn's throne world — a whole damn lot of it. Maybe she knows something we don't. Maybe... we can beat it out of her. Either way, sure ain't for nothing good.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, you're on point. Get boots on the ground and investigate. Drifter, overwatch and comms.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, yeah... I know how it goes.
The Guardian touches down on Savathûn's throne world.
Quagmire, Savathun’s Throne World

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, killer. Luzaku and Fynch got us in here without Savathûn knowin'. But she'll get all three eyes on us soon enough. Which is fine by me — I'm spoilin' for a fight.

lines.speaker: Luzaku
lines.text: This one knows not the answers you seek, but understands your anger.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I doubt that, wormbreath. Just stay out of our way.
The Guardian heads down towards the source of Taken energy.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: There's a tangle of Taken energy down in the Temple of Cunning. Everything points to a new Eversion Anchor — same as the one in the EDZ. Nothin' happens down here without Savathûn's say-so. She must want it for a reason. Got no idea how it fits in with the Dreadnaught, though.

lines.speaker: Luzaku
lines.text: Neither does this one. But in time, all things can be revealed.
Temple of the Wrathful, Savathun’s Throne World
The Guardian approaches the Temple of the Wrathful.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: The anchors move through the Ascendant Plane like a knife through Taken butter. No easy thing. It's hard to punch a hole; even harder to keep it open. But cutting right through a throne world? Those are like barnacles on the backside of the Ascendant Plane. That kinda power makes me nervous.
The Temple of Cunning, Savathun’s Throne World
The Guardian approaches the Temple of Cunning.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: There it is. Just as creepy as you left it.

lines.speaker: Luzaku
lines.text: Walk in the Sky, Guardians.
The Guardian enters the temple and is greeted by Savathûn.

Savathûn: You just can’t stop meddling, can you? You Guardians destroy everything you can’t control. This is my world. My throne. Nothing exists here without my say-so. Including you… So, in light of recent events, I believe we have a few things to discuss. Immaru thanks you for your hospitality, but our transaction is concluded. My Ghost is back at my side, where he belongs. He told me everything. Oh, Eris! What a loss. Poor dear is in a better place. That’s what Humans say, isn’t it? To comfort each other? Is that comforting? There. That’s over and done with; respects paid, condolences offered. Now I have a warning for my favorite Guardian. Stay away from my brother’s Dreadnaught. Stay away from my sister. This is a family matter. And nothing is gained by making an enemy of me. I think Eris would agree. Now leave.
Ghost projects Drifter's image.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You gonna listen to that? You’re gonna let Savathûn talk about Eris like she knew her? You knew her. She never looked away from danger. Always got right into the thick of things. Y’know, she found something in me I thought I’d… lost. Now she’s dead. And what she found’s dead too. I just can’t shake it. That bone-deep feeling. And I felt it before. She’s gone… because I cared.

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: Act I
lines.text: Echoed Warnings

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, hero. How you livin’? Word on the ground is somethin’ big landed in the EDZ. Vanguard needs you to check it out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We believe it originated from the Dreadnaught. Oryx’s flagship… the throne of a king long deposed.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That means Taken. Me ‘n Eris are on our way to Saturn’s orbit.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Go to Trostland, Guardian. The corruption that spread from the Dreadnaught must be found and cut out. And the Drifter and I will staunch its source.
Hangman’s Pass, European Dead Zone
The Guardian touches down in the EDZ.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: The impact site is nearby. Got you as close as I could. Get to Hangman’s Pass. We’re on our approach to the Dreadnaught now.
The Guardian heads to the anomalous blight.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Whatever landed in the EDZ is punching holes into the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rifts, yes. I fear the Taken may not be as leaderless as we hoped. But if the Hive sisters had the inclination, they would have grasped control by now. A Taken Queen. A crown unclaimed does not sit idle long.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Got eyes on the Dreadnaught. Something’s wrong. It’s being… skinned alive.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Flayed of its living flesh.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I’ll find an LZ.
The Guardian clears the Darkness rift.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: We’re on board.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Inside its fetid halls once again. Even without its navigator, this ship holds many terrors.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Ugh, looks worse inside. Cut right down to the bone.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Its flesh is being consumed by Taken decay.
The Dire Taken spring a trap.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Taken blight pushin’ you out. Find a way around it.
The Guardian escapes the Dire Taken ambush.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Somethin’ is doing this on purpose. The Taken are always lookin’ for someone with a backbone strong enough to lead ‘em. It’s one thing to pull Taken from the Ascendant Plane and make ‘em dance. But wringin’ out new ones…

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We cannot allow this. Drifter, with me.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. Let’s keep movin’.
The Guardian finds another way forward.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: An anchor, deployed from the Dreadnaught. Is it attempting to Take the planet? No, an eversion!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Turnin’ Earth inside out. Pullin’ the Ascendant Plane into our reality. Shut it down, hero.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Remove the Taken! Send them screaming into the Ascendant Plane!
The Guardian defeats Gorkall, the Gatekeeper.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The anchor is exposed. Guardian, approach with caution.
The Guardian makes contact with the anchor.

lines.speaker: Act I
lines.text: Echoed Warnings

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You are drawn through Ascendant space, to a tomb no longer at rest in the stars. The Dreadnaught calls to herald our approach.
TRENCHWAY, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian boards the Dreadnaught.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey! We lost you for a minute there. Says you’re on the Dreadnaught?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Drifter

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian. We have discovered a piece of the Tablets of Ruin.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: A long time ago, Oryx wrote down how to Take. Put it on those tablets… But they’re all lost or locked down. Or they should be. What’s a piece doin’ here?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Someone — no. Taken! Get back!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: We got this, Guardian. Hold your position.
The Guardian approaches the Hall of Souls.
THE HALL OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [gasps] I sense a familiar presence. Fingertips on the surface… No. This is new… Something’s wrong! We must find the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Maybe we can… make our way back, or—
A Subjugator drops in and grabs Eris by the throat.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [grunts in pain] Vile… creature!
Eris shoots the Subjugator. It laughs at her and thrusts its lance into her chest.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [gasps, breathes raggedly in pain]
Eris falls limp on the Subjugator's lance.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: No!
The Subjugator drags Eris’ corpse down into the depths of the Dreadnaught. The Drifter jumps down after them.
Felghul, the Requisitioner arrives to stop the Guardian. They defeat the Dread fiends blocking their path.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Grab the artifact and follow my signal! That thing’s got her!
The Guardian acquires a piece of the Tablets of Ruin.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: It’s taking her deeper in the Dreadnaught! Hold on, Moondust! We can’t leave her! We need to get Eris out of here, we need— [distant, steady gunshots] Help! Please! Anyone! [distant gunshots becoming erratic] [frustrated yell]
THE MAUSOLEUM, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian fights off the Dread commanded by the Resonant Knife, First of the Reshaped and resurrects Drifter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [gasps] Eris… [grunts] No, no, no, no, no, no… [pants] Moondust? [whimpers] It’s OK… [sobs] I gotcha. I gotcha… I gotcha… Moonlight… [sobs]
Eris awakens elsewhere…

lines.text: [gasps] [inhales shakily] [exhales] [pants] [laughs joyously] [laughter fades away]

title: Into the Depths I: Operation Thunderbolt — Transcript

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: This is Operation Thunderbolt. Ahsa has alerted us to a shelf of coral infested with a fungal spore we can use. However, it's in hostile territory.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Always is, was, will be.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Indeed. Forward intel reports a Wrathborn Servitor patrols the area—and it is not alone. You have two sites to hit. Deploy excavation equipment, defend, and extract. Deputy Commander. Guardian. Divide and conquer. Bring the Drifter what he needs.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I'm reading you, Guardians.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: So the old man asked you to babysit?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I'm your air superiority.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: From aboard a Cabal cruiser? Never thought I'd see the day.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Meet the Empress. Then I'll hear your judgement.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Fair enough. To be honest, it's just nice to be back running with the both of you.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: On that, we can agree.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: That Servitor's onto us. I just met contact. Let's hustle, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: It's been an age since I've seen you fight, Sloane. Had you been with us on the dragon hunts… You're the bait now. Guardian, you're next.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Goes against all my instincts, but I'll try to make myself look delicious.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Deploying drill. Let's get loud, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: You'll need to keep those drills fueled and intact.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Drill offline! Refuel it!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: DROWN THIS GIFT, AND REVEL IN IT. KNEEL, THAT I MAY LAY MY BLADE ACROSS THINE BREAST… THE QUIVER OF YOUR HEART TO RESONATE ITS BLACK EDGE.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Get out… of my head…

lines.speaker: Sloane

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey there, hero. While you were taking a dip in the methane, I detected something on the ocean floor… and it ain't native to Titan. I've seen it before. On the Glykon. On the Leviathan. On my own ship, too. An organism that's all about forming psychic connections. Seems it's growing like coral down in the depths. I'm thinking we gather it up and use it to amplify Sloane's link to the creature. I can modify my Gambit equipment to bank that stuff and harness its power… but I'll need some Golden Age parts to do it. Just so happens the Arcology is full of Golden Age tech waiting to be salvaged. You help me collect it, and I'll fix up the bank. Then it's just a matter of… well, heh, diving into the depths of the methane sea and dredging up what Sloane needs. All while trying not to drown, of course. Nothing you can't handle! So what do you say? Ready for another swim?

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What's the word, brother? All this Golden Age tech is impressive stuff. Almost makes you wonder how they lost back then… ya dig? About that… if we're looking to win this time, I need Savathûn's swamp to wash up a few finishing touches for my rig. Crackin' skulls and lootin' hauls is your bag, hero. That's why you're headed to her throne world. That Pyramid Savvy brought down—it's cut off from the Witness. Scorn bigwigs been diggin' tech we can use out of that burning heap. All you have to do is find 'em and take it. Then you let ol' Drifter worry about the kit-bashin'. Easy. Hey, uh… one more thing. Xivu drippin' nonsense in your head too? She's been recounting some of my… more "heroic" exploits. Dark Age's been on my mind. You know how the past is. You pull the trigger, and people die… so you don't have to. Then someone comes along and wants to forgive you for that. Like it's fine. Won't ask what Xivu's dredgin' up for a killer like you. Wouldn't be polite. Thunderguns down there, though? Been under pressure so long, everybody's looking for cracks. Don't get me wrong! Coin to table, she's been through it. But I don't think Sloane's looking to be told it's fine. 'Cause it ain't. 'Cause it needs to be ugly to win. And then… you live with it. See ya on the other side.

A large form of the Emissary appears before the Guardian.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: We stand at the precipice of history. What you do here changes the cosmic balance forever. You have made allies of dangerous beings. Gods and god pretenders. How long before your company involves you in something you can't come back from? Those I serve have so much to learn from you. You are their greatest curiosity. The agent on whom all fates converge. The Dredgen presents a special prize to the Nine. He is an anomaly. An elemental balance. A grand experiment. We remember his Trial.
The Guardian experiences a vision of the Drifter's Derelict without its Haul trailing behind it. Inside, the Drifter plays a game of cards with a Shadow of Yor.

lines.speaker: The Shadow
lines.text: It's about time someone taught you respect, little man.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [laughs] Someone like you? I know you all keep tabs on me.

lines.speaker: The Shadow
lines.text: Yeah. You been strayin'. You don't even use his name no more.
The Shadow throws a card on the table.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well, that's why I'm still breathing, brother. Gambit is a chance at salvation. Take it.
The Drifter places a card on the table, winning the game. The Shadow stands up in anger and points his Thorn at the Drifter. The Drifter holds up his hands in surrender.

lines.speaker: The Shadow
lines.text: You were always so afraid Shin would get you. Sorry, old friend.
The Drifter points to his right hand with his left. With a flick of his wrist, a Mote of Dark appears in his hand. He points in the direction behind the Shadow.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Behind you.
The Shadow turns around to see a Taken Captain appear behind him. The Taken Captain attacks the Shadow, sending him flying over the nearby railing.

lines.speaker: The Shadow
lines.text: [screams]

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [laughs]
The Taken Captain approaches the Drifter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Whoa, boy. Easy. Easy now…

The Taken Captain roars and reaches out towards the Drifter. The Drifter recoils. The Taken Captain is suddenly sucked into a portal and disappears. The Emissary appears in the place of the Taken Captain.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Dredgen.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Nah, not anymore. It's Drifter now.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: You have proven yourself worthy. Accept this gift from the Nine.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: A gift?
The Derelict suddenly starts shaking.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What gift?
The vision ends with a view of the Derelict with the Haul now behind it. The Guardian is back in the presence of the large form of the Emissary.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Only two others have transcended their design. The first, an hourglass counting down with infinite patience. The second, a forgotten blade sharpened anew. And now, the Dredgen. Visit us again. We wish for you to understand what we understand. For now, it is my purpose to speak to you and you alone… but only if you remain worthy.

lines.text: Roam free? I pay her for access to that rig. And I have to sweep Hive just to get in. When I asked to lower said fee, she shoved me into a locker.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Vanguard trusts you in ways I will never understand.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey. Pot, kettle, black.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's a trust we can use.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Now that we agree on.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Titan

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey. Three Eyes. Shaxx says you sang him a lil' ditty.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Shaxx. Chunky Titan. One horn. Did you sing him a song on the Moon?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What a senseless question.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. I didn't think so.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Stay off this channel. Should I need you, I'll call — wait.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Uh, I didn't hang up.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Does that oaf still keep that skull with him?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: In the Tower? Yeah. Hangs it over his spot. I wouldn't have tangoed with that thing.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Desperate times. This… 'lil ditty. Did it go… ? [hums]

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That would be the one. Heh. What is it?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn's Song. It's a viral chant. It can never be unheard. Now that Savathûn has announced herself, relics of the Dark across the system have begun to awaken… Tell Shaxx to remove that Skull immediately.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sister, I already tried.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What did that oaf say?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: No.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Titan

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This looks like the New Pacific Arcology.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: On Titan? What's that got to do with the Darkness? Sloane has that neighborhood on lockdown.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive nest there, in the ruins of the Golden Age. And a leviathan of untold strength has made it her home.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I danced with the Dark. The Hive are NOT the Dark.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive are the children of Darkness. As we are of the Light. I'll speak to Sloane. Maybe she's seen something.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Brother Vance. So sad.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Seeing Mercury makes me think of the cultists who ran around chasing Osiris' coattails. They used to run the Trials. They used to mean something. Be sombodies. No one talks to Vance anymore. I mean, I do. I still don't have some of those guns.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have no idea who you're talking about.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. Never mind.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's like they carved a sector of Mercury onto this plane. Saint and Osiris need to hear about this.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, well, make sure you tell 'em both. News travels slow between those two.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I don't fathom.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I told you don't cuss at me.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What do you mean news travels slow between Saint and Osiris?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well, call me old-fashioned, but if I broke time to save my knight in shining armor, I'd want 'em to stop foolin' around and climb my tower. But, uh, word on the wind is, no one's seen 'em meet in person.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That doesn't mean they don't.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You saying you heard different.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I know it. What would you do if your loved ones returned?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I don't have those. But, if I did… Wouldn't be sittin' here flappin' gums with you.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Exactly. The pigeon and the phoenix exalt in their own way. Leave them be.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Heh. Yeah. Maybe. What would you do if you could get 'em back?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Your fireteam.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Wouldn't be sittin' here flappin' gums with you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. That's fair.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This looks like Mercury. But no traces of Osiris's Light. Or Saint's. It's a counterfeit.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: This is Nine space. They control reality here. And they did this for a reason.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It must be part of their answer to the question. How insufferable.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I'm launching spectral analysis off the Guardian's position… It's not exactly our Mercury. No Tree of Probabilities… no Infinite Forest.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What do you seek? A means to walk the corridors of time? Haven't you learned from Osiris' mistake?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Osiris took the Sundial with him… wherever it is he went. I always wanted to take that thing for a spin.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Let's see. Power on switch here. Signal jammer here. Choose frequency, and… Hey, Orin. You there? Orin!

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Dredgen speaks.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I noticed you all stopped tryin' to… boil my brain lately. And I know you love tryin' to spook me. So, what's the deal? You scared, now that Savathûn's rode into town?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Witch Queen is yet another piece on the board. She has agency. But the board has not changed.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So, the Nine still need you out there?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Nine are inextricable from each other, and their Emissary.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, that's what I thought.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Were you saying something, rat? My channel cut out.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Just yellin' at the wind, Three Eyes.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Dredgen.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's a first. What's up, you lunatic?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Forgotten Blade. She has been asking about our benefactor. Orin.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You mean Eris? Yeah, I guess she did know Orin back in the day. What'd you say?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Do you trust this Blade?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I trust no one, you psychopath.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: What does "Orin" mean to the Blade?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well, hell if I know. I don't understand people like them.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Lightbearers?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Friends.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mercury

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Dredgen. Let's play a game. Your kind reveals so much in the choices you make.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What the hell does that mean? You know what - okay, I'll bite.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Okay, why is it getting hot? Do you feel that, Guardian? I can't… I can't see anything.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The night has enveloped you. This is a world full of Dark. No sparks.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What's that smell?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The stench of the dead.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Am I dead? I hope so, because what I'm smelling, I don't want to be touching.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: You stand atop a dead world. A collapse.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Get me outta here.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Very well. Your feet find purchase in shifting sands.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Holy hell, what're you doing now? It's too bright!

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The sun is blinding. This is a world is full of Light. No shadows. A creature runs into you in its blindness; it nearly bowls you over.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [grunts] Hey, watch it! What was that? That's not funny.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: It has lived here all its life. Too long. It is very old. But if you could see, you would see it appears young.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Okay, when I said "get me outta here," I meant I'm done with your bull-

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: It grabs your hand.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Don't touch me.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: It begs. It begs you for help.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You call this a game?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: It begs you for death. On this world, ruled by full Light, it cannot die. It has companions that are as long-lived. It hates them, and they hate it. It will never end. It will never die.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Get me outta here, Orin! It won't let go. I can smell it rotting!

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: And it smells you! You won't help it?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I said I'm done!

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What the hell is wrong with you, you lunatic?

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: You asked about Light and Dark. Come find us again any time, Dredgen. Guardian.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Io

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rat.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What's up, Three Eyes?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What do you seek here, in this oubliette of the Nine?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: For the last time, I'm just helping the Vanguard out on a consultation basis.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Does Zavala know you're here:

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What Zavala doesn't know he won't have to worry about.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Dredgen never changes.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You stay outta this, lunatic!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You watch the Emissary. And vice versa. What do the Nine want with you?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Nothin'. Drifter's just… passin' through.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: With a slice of the Nine Realms attached to your cargo bay.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Io

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This reminds me of the Quarry near Asher's lab.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: On Io? That's where that Pyramid parked. Right over the Tree of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This is the last place the Traveler touched in our solar system. Perhaps the Darkness wishes to undo the work of the Traveler. What are the Nine trying to say with this? Is this their answer to the question?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Must be. Too bad I don't speak lunatic.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Io

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Three Eyes. You spending all your time on Io now?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Or the Moon. Depending on the weather.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What do you think of all this?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: All of what?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: The black fleet. The end of the line. End of the Light.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It hasn't come to that. Not yet.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: It hasn't been dark enough.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Look at the sky. Nightfall's comin'.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We'll live in the night if we have to. I've been there before. So have you. So has the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: It ain't pleasant.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. But necessary. For what follows.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: And what's that?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Dawn.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Io

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Three Eyes. Check this out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What is it now?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I finally opened my Dawning gift from Eva Levante. She got me this bulldozer of a book from the Golden Age. It's full of definitions of words! Never seen anything like it. Heh, must've had a lotta time back then.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The City scholars publish a new dictionary every couple of years…

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So, uh, I went and looked up one of those nicknames you gave me: "meretricious rogue."

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Uh huh.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Listen, Moondust. Hand to my heart, I am flattered. But Drifter ain't got time for all that! Let's keep this businesslike.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I'm surprised you can read.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. I'm better at math, though.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Io

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Moondust. You're no Vanguard. Why do you hang with them?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ikora and Zavala are dear friends. Even if we don't always see eye to eye… to eye.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You should take it easy. Learn to relax. You're Ghostless now. Go live your life. Vanguard business won't end well for you.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ghostless or not, my objectives would not change.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I've known Ghostless all my lives. Trust me. Live it while you can. No one gets a happy ending.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: And you think those with Ghosts do?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Actually, no. Guess I don't.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: This is Mars… one of the old man's many homes. I always wondered if his bite was as bad as his bark. But he went down like a punk. Heh.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rasputin?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's his name. Osiris was bankin' on him. Kicked down that old Russian's door and threatened him with a gun to get him to help. He didn't know I was watching. And laughing. Heh.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: There's no humor in that. Rasputin murdered the Iron Lords. Stayed in the shadows to save himself as humankind burned.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well, yeah. When you put it that way, it doesn't sound funny at all, Three Eyes!
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Darkness has encroached Mars.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, so what? We knew THAT the second the Pyramids jumped into the system and punched Rasputin in the head.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ana's working on bringing the Warmind back online. Have faith.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, well, the old man went down like a sack full'a Ghosts. Maybe Ana can find a sturdier case to put him in. Like a… vending machine or something.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The two of you think alike. Her plan might surprise you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: If she wants to impress me, she should get a job — Hunter Vanguard, for instance.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She doesn't want to impress you. No one does.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Mars. Home of the oldest earthling in the system. Now, what're y'all trying to say with this?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Perhaps it's Ana Bray they're watching.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, they're not the only ones — I been waiting on her to take that seat. Why haven't you numbskulls filled it?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What seat?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Cayde-6's personal toilet. Hunter Vanguard seat.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [laughs] Look at the Hunters, rat. Your question answers itself.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, guess I wouldn't want to be stuck herding cats and doing paperwork either. Shaxx would do it just to spite y'all.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: He is welcome to try.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rat!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey. How you living, Moondust?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rasputin prevented an extinction-level event when he smashed the Almighty above the City.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Why does everybody say it like that? "Extinction-level event." We're down to one city! I could cause an extinction-level event.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: And for now the Warmind is gone. What will we do the next time the clock strikes midnight?
The Witch Queen waits to strike. The emperor of the Cabal has yet to act in the face of the paracausal fleet. The end could come at any time.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Sister, I've had a bug-out bag since the Dark Age. I'll be all right.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You've changed since the last time I saw you, Three Eyes. I mean, since you were Two Eyes way back when. Not that we called you that. [laughs]

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That Eris perished in the tunnels under the Moon, along with her Ghost and her friends. She died not knowing whether anything in this universe could bring hope against the likes of Crota and the Hive. She had the Light. And it was not enough.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Nope. It still ain't.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She died with hope in her grasp. With that hope came one last life.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Some people might envy just one last life.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Some people are fools.
// OPTIONAL
The Guardian approaches the Emissary of the Nine at Mars

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: If this were authentic Mars, Ana Bray's setup would be a short walk from away. That sister needs to get her head out of the past. She could be so much more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She should learn from you?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Shouldn't everyone?
Singularity, Nine Relams, Unknown Space
The Guardian traverses the "sea". The Guardian eventually enters a room with a structure that appears similar to the one in the Queen's Court, where the Guardian previously met with Mara Sov.

Three iterations of the Kell Echo, a part of the Nine's answer to the Guardian's question, appear. The Guardian distributes Motes of Light and Dark. The Guardian casts away the iterations of the Kell Echo. Devoured Ogre appears. The Guardian defeats Devoured Ogre and descends to another room filled with dark entropy. The Kell Echo appears. The Guardian battles the Kell Echo as dark entropy grows.
// OPTIONAL
If the Guardian does not defeat the Kell Echo before it flees the room with dark entropy

The Kell Echo flees the room. The Guardian sinks back into the arena. Three iterations of the Kell Echo appears. The Guardian distributes Motes of Light and Dark. The Guardian casts away the iterations of the Kell Echo. Devoured Ogre appears. The Guardian defeats Devoured Ogre and descends to another room filled with dark entropy. The Kell Echo appears.
The Guardian defeats the Kell Echo and is teleported into a room with the Emissary of the Nine and Nine floating lights.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Nine have spoken! Their answer is complete.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then we learned nothing.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I wouldn't say that. Clearly, the Nine pass no judgment on Dark or Light. And they love passing judgment. Trust. That means in their eyes, the two are the same.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Zavala will disagree.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's some bloodlust, Hero. It hit me when you were tearing that last pack of Taken apart. What the Nine are trying to say: Light. Dark. It don't matter.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Light and Dark are not the same.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Didn't say the same. Just - the difference don't matter.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: And so the Nine have spoken.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That's your answer? That's incomprehensible.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I mean, that's just your opinion, man. Nah, I think this made sense.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Which part?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well… we got paid, didn't we?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We have research to conduct, rat. You drag the Guardian into another mess like this, and I'll push you through an airlock.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The Nine have given you their answer. We hope it sates your curiosity. You've certainly taught us much.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Uh… you're welcome. Let us know if there's anything else we can do.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rat. You're useless.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Relax, Moondust. We got what we came for. Let's leave the giant head alone.
// OPTIONAL

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: The answer is complete. You survived. Well done.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: So you do understand the stakes of this reality. And you allowed the rat to lead the Guardian into dire straits. The person you were would never have allowed this to come to pass.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: "Orin" is longer here.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If that's true, I would have you pass a word to the Nine.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: And what word is that?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Run.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: The Survival Guide, The Investigation

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Dark Age was different times. We had no City. Warlords and Iron Lords tore up the whole world tryin' to prove who was better, what was worth fighting for. I was busy tryin' not to starve. You ever go hungry 'til you keeled over? We did that a lot in the Dark Age. Our Ghosts would bring us back - still hungry. Really pissed me off. This one time I found a village to hide out in. Bunch of huts, really. Good people. They gave me work, and I kept my Light a secret while I performed some minor miracles. Then the Iron Lords rolled into town. My Ghost stayed outta sight, and they were none the wiser. They cut a deal with us (as if we had a choice) - paid us to let let them hide out 'til some Warlords showed up. Then ambushed 'em. But we all got caught in the crossfire. My neighbor's kid told me something that still bounces 'round my head to this day. Right before the light went out in her tiny eyes, she whispered, "I can't feel anything." Yeah. I couldn't either. That's all I got. Cut the tape.
Sojourner's Rest, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Hey, kid. It's me. The Drifter. And this is "How to Drift," Part Three: Never Trust Your Ghost. He's a tool. A connection to the Light. Not a friend - not in any way that counts. You think he's saving your hide, bringing you back? He's saving his own. I don't care what your Guardian dogma says. I don't care what your little buddy has told you. We don't know what Ghosts are. They sound friendly, right? But I met some Ghosts in the Dark Age would kill you for a blue engram. Then spit on your grave. All so they could grow their Light a little more. Make a "stronger connection to the Traveler." Whatever the hell that means. You're an idiot if you think those Ghosts aren't still around. Take mine, for example. Really creeps me out… Cut the tape, Ghost. And don't gimme that look. You know where we stand.
Scavenger's Den, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: If you're gonna hang with me, you need to know about the Shadows of Yor. They follow the edicts of a very bad man named Dredgen Yor. And what're his Shadows after? Everything the Light can't provide. I thought they could help me find an answer to the battles of Light versus Light that raged during the Dark Age. But the longer I flew with them, the more I saw they're blind as all those who follow the Traveler. One albatross for another. I was done with 'em. And that title I give out? Dredgen? I did it to piss them off. Draw the Shadows out where I could see 'em. Worked like a charm. I love all you lil' Guardians. You're so forthright. So eager to please. That make you angry? Good. Use it.
Winding Cove, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: You can't be the Drifter's partner and not know about Shin Malphur. The Man with the Golden Gun is still out there. He's a hero. The stuff of legend. Naturally, he's after my Ghost. He wouldn't be the first. But everyone and their grandma has a Malfeasance Hand Cannon by now. I think we're OK if Mr. Malphur ever shows his face. He follows the Light like a zealot, and he ends all those who would consort with the dark because of one man who went rogue. It's not his Golden Gun you should be afraid of, kid. It's his idea that one man can decide he makes the rules, and when you cross him, he can take everything from you. Doesn't sit right with me. Never will.
Excavation Site XII, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Mighty kind of the Vanguard to let me sleep in the Annex. Doesn't get cold down there. Much. Do I trust them for it? Hell no. They're gettin' people killed just like the Iron Lords. Yes, people. Like you and me. Just 'cuz we got the Light doesn't mean we ever stop bein' that. Don't you let them tell you otherwise. And that mission statement of theirs? Protecting the City? Heh. Humanity's done, kid. You can't save 'em. Even if you could wrap a Ward of Dawn around this whole town, they'd start dying all on their own. Every single one you save becomes just a memory. I don't need any more of those. You'll get there. You'll see.
Skydock IV, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I thought the City had made you all soft. But there's this hardliner - a Warlock named Aunor. Pretty sure she's trying to kill me. She crashed a handoff between me and the Shadows of Yor in Midtown. My, uh, buddies took a hostage, and she took out a City block getting them back. Some people didn't make it out. How's that for hypocrisy? She jumped the shark on that one. I woulda' talked them down. No one had to get hurt. I hope the Vanguard are happy. I heard word from Hunter dens across the City. This Aunor's been building a crew to look into me and the Shadows. Buncha clowns. One'a them is this Guardian - a hero of the Red War just like you - one'a Cayde's friends… just like you. A Gambit regular. 'Cept they're a snitch. Have been all this time. I don't mind. As long as they keep bringing Motes, we're square. You watch your back out there, partner. Your friends might not be what they seem.
Flooded Chasm, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Hey, you made it to the last part of my lil' seminar. You caught me without much else to say. Already talked your ear off. But I guess there is one thing. I want you to know that you're the closest thing to a wheel-horse I've had in, oh, a thousand years. I can see you making that face like you just swallowed some Scorn blood. "Wheel-horse" is an expression, kid. It's Dark Age for "we're tight." That's what you kids say, right? So here's something I never had the chance to tell anyone else on account of they're dead or tryin'a kill me. Don't give in to hope. That gets you killed. Take every day as it is. Trade your jumpship for a long-range hauler and see the universe while you can. I want the best for you, kid. And you won't find that in this system. Speaking of which. the Collapse wasn't the last extinction-level event to hit humanity. Ol' Drifter's seen another one comin'. Everything I'm building in the Nine Realms is preparation. There's a few seats I'm savin'. One of 'em is for you. If you want it.

lines.text: by Eruke
Twilight Gap, Earth

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Welcome to Twilight Gap. The place where humanity nearly died.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian? There are no Crucible matches scheduled for the Gap today.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Osiris? How did you know we were here?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I saw the Guardian arrive.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You're spying on him?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I watch all Guardians of stature.
The Guardian collects Timelost Fragments from three Redjack Frames.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: The battle against the Fallen that took place here: it made Titans famous. Not in a good way.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You say that like Warlocks and Hunters sat on their hands.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Get off this line, Osiris. I'm showing the Guardian something very important.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Make me.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: [laughs] You would not survive that. But you make me laugh. You can stay.
The Guardian collects Timelost Fragments from another three Redjack Frames.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: The fabled Gjallarhorns of legend were constructed from the armor of Guardians who died here. Final deaths, all of them.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: What happened here wasn't your fault. Or mine.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: We would have lost if not for Shaxx's last stand. With Nkechi and Adbi and Truce. Liu Feng. Ana. They all believed in him.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: He's more stubborn than you.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I have never known him to give up. Ever. He's taught me a lot.
The Guardian collects Timelost Fragments from another three Redjack Frames.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Guardian, whether you wanted it or not… You've become the best of us. Or close to it. Without you, there would be no Saint-14. The battle of Twilight Gap might have been lost.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Saint, your ego knows no bounds.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: And you have a fat head, Warlock.
The Guardian collects the final Timelost Fragment from a Redjack Frame.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: What's all this? Guardian, there are no sanctioned matches at Twilight Gap right now.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That's exactly what I was saying.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Osiris?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Warlord Shaxx. As I live and breathe.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Saint-14. I thought you were dead.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Brother. I have always hated you.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: [laughs]

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: They'll be at this for awhile, Guardian. Feel free to move about the universe. I'm sure you have better things to do than listen to this.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Shaxx. The Crucible — what have you done with it?

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: It's not the Crucible by which you and I were forged. Took years, but Twilight Gap changed everything. After that day out there, the Crucible went from a place where we settled our differences to a place where we bettered ourselves.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I heard you give out some amazing weapons to your fighters.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Those weapons are earned. With blood, sweat, and tears.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Are you sure your fighters are bettering themselves? Or chasing hardware?

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Listen: Even Guardians need to get paid once in a while.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: [scoffs] When you put it that way, you sound like that sad, lonely rat man who lives downstairs.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: The Drifter? Keep your enemies close, right? Watch him for us.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I was shocked to see Eris Morn again. She is not as she was.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: She represents the best of us. Ghostless. And stronger than you and me both.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Perhaps we could get her a bigger gun. She would not have to carry that rock all the time. Speaking of guns: uh, tell me more about these weapons you've crafted. I am not allowed to earn them. I have heard you made one for young Redrix. Redrix's Claymore?

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Broadsword.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Whatever. There was a Hand Cannon as well. You made one for Josef. Luna's Howl.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Yes. Luna was his dog. She passed on the Moon. Fighting Hive.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Those bastards. I'm glad you killed their King.
