title: Quest: The Survival Guide, The Investigation — Transcript

lines.text: by DrJazzyBebop
Trostland, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.
The tapes play the same dialogue regardless of whether the Guardian has sided with the Vanguard or the Drifter.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Hidden Messages, Honor Among Thieves

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Dark Age was different times. We had no City. Warlords and Iron Lords tore up the whole world tryin' to prove who was better, what was worth fighting for. I was busy tryin' not to starve. You ever go hungry 'til you keeled over? We did that a lot in the Dark Age. Our Ghosts would bring us back - still hungry. Really pissed me off. This one time I found a village to hide out in. Bunch of huts, really. Good people. They gave me work, and I kept my Light a secret while I performed some minor miracles. Then the Iron Lords rolled into town. My Ghost stayed outta sight, and they were none the wiser. They cut a deal with us (as if we had a choice) - paid us to let let them hide out 'til some Warlords showed up. Then ambushed 'em. But we all got caught in the crossfire. My neighbor's kid told me something that still bounces 'round my head to this day. Right before the light went out in her tiny eyes, she whispered, "I can't feel anything." Yeah. I couldn't either. That's all I got. Cut the tape.
Skydock IV, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Hey, kid. It's me. The Drifter. And this is "How to Drift," Part Three: Never Trust Your Ghost. He's a tool. A connection to the Light. Not a friend - not in any way that counts. You think he's saving your hide, bringing you back? He's saving his own. I don't care what your Guardian dogma says. I don't care what your little buddy has told you. We don't know what Ghosts are. They sound friendly, right? But I met some Ghosts in the Dark Age would kill you for a blue engram. Then spit on your grave. All so they could grow their Light a little more. Make a "stronger connection to the Traveler." Whatever the hell that means. You're an idiot if you think those Ghosts aren't still around. Take mine, for example. Really creeps me out… Cut the tape, Ghost. And don't gimme that look. You know where we stand.
Flooded Chasm, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: If you're gonna hang with me, you need to know about the Shadows of Yor. They follow the edicts of a very bad man named Dredgen Yor. And what're his Shadows after? Everything the Light can't provide. I thought they could help me find an answer to the battles of Light versus Light that raged during the Dark Age. But the longer I flew with them, the more I saw they're blind as all those who follow the Traveler. One albatross for another. I was done with 'em. And that title I give out? Dredgen? I did it to piss them off. Draw the Shadows out where I could see 'em. Worked like a charm. I love all you lil' Guardians. You're so forthright. So eager to please. That make you angry? Good. Use it.
Sojourner's Camp, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: You can't be the Drifter's partner and not know about Shin Malphur. The Man with the Golden Gun is still out there. He's a hero. The stuff of legend. Naturally, he's after my Ghost. He wouldn't be the first. But everyone and their grandma has a Malfeasance Hand Cannon by now. I think we're OK if Mr. Malphur ever shows his face. He follows the Light like a zealot, and he ends all those who would consort with the dark because of one man who went rogue. It's not his Golden Gun you should be afraid of, kid. It's his idea that one man can decide he makes the rules, and when you cross him, he can take everything from you. Doesn't sit right with me. Never will.
Excavation Site XII, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Mighty kind of the Vanguard to let me sleep in the Annex. Doesn't get cold down there. Much. Do I trust them for it? Hell no. They're gettin' people killed just like the Iron Lords. Yes, people. Like you and me. Just 'cuz we got the Light doesn't mean we ever stop bein' that. Don't you let them tell you otherwise. And that mission statement of theirs? Protecting the City? Heh. Humanity's done, kid. You can't save 'em. Even if you could wrap a Ward of Dawn around this whole town, they'd start dying all on their own. Every single one you save becomes just a memory. I don't need any more of those. You'll get there. You'll see.
Winding Cove, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I thought the City had made you all soft. But there's this hardliner - a Warlock named Aunor. Pretty sure she's trying to kill me. She crashed a handoff between me and the Shadows of Yor in Midtown. My, uh, buddies took a hostage, and she took out a City block getting them back. Some people didn't make it out. How's that for hypocrisy? She jumped the shark on that one. I woulda' talked them down. No one had to get hurt. I hope the Vanguard are happy. I heard word from Hunter dens across the City. This Aunor's been building a crew to look into me and the Shadows. Buncha clowns. One'a them is this Guardian - a hero of the Red War just like you - one'a Cayde's friends… just like you. A Gambit regular. 'Cept they're a snitch. Have been all this time. I don't mind. As long as they keep bringing Motes, we're square. You watch your back out there, partner. Your friends might not be what they seem.
Scavenger's Den, European Dead Zone
The Guardian finds one of the Drifter's tapes.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Hey, you made it to the last part of my lil' seminar. You caught me without much else to say. Already talked your ear off. But I guess there is one thing. I want you to know that you're the closest thing to a wheel-horse I've had in, oh, a thousand years. I can see you making that face like you just swallowed some Scorn blood. "Wheel-horse" is an expression, kid. It's Dark Age for "we're tight." That's what you kids say, right? So here's something I never had the chance to tell anyone else on account of they're dead or tryin'a kill me. Don't give in to hope. That gets you killed. Take every day as it is. Trade your jumpship for a long-range hauler and see the universe while you can. I want the best for you, kid. And you won't find that in this system. Speaking of which. the Collapse wasn't the last extinction-level event to hit humanity. Ol' Drifter's seen another one comin'. Everything I'm building in the Nine Realms is preparation. There's a few seats I'm savin'. One of 'em is for you. If you want it.

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: Act II
lines.text: Rites of the Deep

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, uh… probably didn’t expect to hear from me again, huh? Bailing was a bad move. I admit it. Soon as I turned around, I picked up Sloane’s message. I thought she was gonna chew me out. She didn’t. Just told me what I needed to do next. Anyway, I’m here now, and Eris needs me. Need us. Find me on the Dreadnaught.
THE MAUSOLEUM, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian arrives in the Dreadnaught and approaches Drifter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Call me crazy. Hell, most already do. But I can’t shake this. I won’t. The Dreadnaught has one foot in the Ascendant Plane. Maybe… that’s how she reached out. Find her. She’s here. I should’ve known… I should’ve known. It’d take more than that.
The Guardian travels to the Founts.
THE FOUNTS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So I hear you got some shards of Oryx’s sword, Willbreaker. Puttin’ it back together won’t be easy. All that Taken mojo you picked up from Sloane is a good start. But jammin’ it into Crota’s hilt? That’ll take some real freaky Hive magic. Eris ain’t here, so… I’m stepping up. It ain’t the same, but I picked up a few tricks along the way. I’ll do my part, and you do you, hero.
The Guardian places the Shards in the forge.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: The forge hungers for Taken wills.
The Drifter uses a Hive ritual to conjure crystallised essence.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That’s it! Get those pieces together!
The Guardian slays Taken with the splintered Willbreaker.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That thing’s unstable, but we can still do this. Get to the rift, and I’ll be ready.
The Guardian passes through the Ascendant Plane into the next area.
HALL OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You — you are the one who wounds! You are the blade-undulled! Damn it, Toland. I… She is the… blade-unforgotten! She is the… deep-scoured, vengeance-fed deathless! I am… I’m… oh, hell, just kill something with the damn sword!
The Guardian defeats targets with the splintered Willbreaker

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: The Hive gods were conjured back by their natures. Yeah, I read the Books of Sorrow! A fella gets curious. Anyway, Eris was the God of Vengeance. So go get some!
The Guardian defeats Alphrak and Raphrax, Keepers of the Rift.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Cut into the rift, Guardian! Cut the space between!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eris! Do it, Guardian! I’m on my way!

lines.speaker: Act II
lines.text: Rites of the Deep
The Guardian cuts into space and enters the newly made portal.
NOISELESS CHANTRY, ERIS’S THRONE WORLD

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian. Behold the vast cathedral of my soul. As Hive, I slit Savathûn’s throat. In doing so, I made an incision into the Ascendant Plane. This became a world. A throne. It will protect my essence and restore my form. Here, I am resurrected. Here, I am omnipotent.
Drifter enters through his own portal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Drifter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I thought you were gone, I…

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. My end… was not bitter. It was sweet. This is my vindication. They were wrong. All of them. I am not sick, I am not mad. And I am no lost cause fit only for self-sacrifice. My throne… is wondrous, and eternal… as am I.
The Drifter and Eris Morn hold hands.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Always were.
They separate and Eris turns to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian. I have not sat idle in this place. I have heard whispers through the wall… Is it true? Has the Taken King returned?
A cutscene begins.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I formed my throne with the stroke of a sword… as the Hive gods did long ago. Their tribute and blood coalesced into worlds. You have seen Oryx’s throne. His Dreadnaught, his court. What he called the High War. Here, the memory of the Taken King recognises his equal. His killer. His heir. You. But his sisters will come to claim him, as brother and as instrument of power. Xivu Arath was sundered from her throne, as she was sundered from her siblings. She would retake it all and return to their path of death and conquest. While Savathûn in her High Coven, having claimed the Light, wishes to escape. Both the vows made to the worms and the lie that drove the siblings to that bargain. But their designs will be unmade. Their desires, their undoing. I name my throne the High Heresy, formed in opposition to the Hive. Here, I am heresiarch. Here, I am jailer. For my throne will be Oryx’s prison.

title: Secure the Cargo — Transcript

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Thanks for helping your ol' pal Drifter with this... delicate situation, hero. I had a delivery headed towards the Last City when these House Salvation goons hijacked it. Now I just need you to get in there and... expedite my shipment. I'll let you know what we're looking for once you're inside.
Technocrat's Iron, Europa

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I don't blame House Salvation for skimming a little cream off the trade routes. Couldn't have been easy after their head honcho got turned into a popsicle. But I didn't think they have the guts to try something like this! Once we get my cargo back, you'll see what I mean.
The Guardian fights through the Salvation Fallen.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Gettin' warmer. Our misappropriated shipment is just ahead.
The Guardian locates and inspects the cargo.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Who's there? Drifter? Is that you?

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I'm there in spirit, boss. I... finessed the Guardian into doing the actual rescuing.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: You let the Guardian see me like this? We'll have words once I'm out of here.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: About that... first, let's discuss the matter of our hazard pay.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: What? We had a deal! I will not be leveraged by an amateur extortionist.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Sure thing, boss. We'll just ship you back to the Tangled Shore. Queen Mara's got a handsome bounty on your ugly mug. Could be quite the payday.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Tell you what: House Salvation commandeered my old Ketch. If you can fight your way there, it's yours.
The Spider slips the Guardian a mysterious key.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: My associates will join you along the way. Give them a lift, and we'll call it even.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: [chuckles] Hear that, hero? We got ourselves a new ride! Just gotta break it out of impound.
The Guardian goes off in search of Spider's Ketch.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: There's something you should know. I overheard some Dregs talking.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: While you were hiding in your kennel?

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: [grunts] House Salvation is rallying. Someone's kicked the hornet's nest. They're looking for something left over from the Dark Ages.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Sounds ominous. But I'm sure the Guardian can handle it.
The Guardian meets Halsiks fighting with several members of Salvation. They help him defeat them.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: That's Halsiks, one of my trusted associates. He's deadly with a Wire Rifle. Useful if you're pinned down.
The Guardian follows Halsiks onward towards the Ketch. They find several more of Spider's crew battling with Salvation.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Sounds like you've found my remaining crew. Help them clear out this rabble!
The Guardian helps Flotsiks, Jetsiks, Ransiks, and SCUR-V with the Salvation forces.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Meet the rest of my associates. They're no good to me dead. Make sure to bring them back alive.
The Guardian follows the crew onwards.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: You weren't lying about these House Salvation jokers! They're all riled up. What'd you say they're looking for?

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Relics. Antiquities of some kind.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Mm, that's awfully esoteric for a buncha rubes like these. They gotta be taking orders from someone. Who the hell's calling the shots around here.
Keelhal of House Salvation ambushes the Guardian.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: That must be the big boss in charge. Take 'em out, hero!
The Guardian defeats Keelhal with the help of Spider's crew. They examine Eramis's Stasis prison.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Aw, hell. The Witness must've broken Eramis out. No wonder House Salvation's scrambling.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: So, the Shipstealer is back in play. The artifact she's after...

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Price of her freedom, I bet.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Ooh... imagine the resale value!

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Luckily, we got a clean ship, and a dirty crew to chase her with.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Do me a favor, Guardian. Don't let this clown pilot my Ketch!

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Come on now, Spider. I'll treat her like she was my own.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: That's what I'm worried about.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Only thing you better worry about is the welcome you'll get back in the Last City. Let's ride, Guardian!

title: Semaphore Signals III: Drifter and Eris — Transcript

lines.text: by Destiny Lore Vault
Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a conversation on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I kept this part quiet. I think half of those pirate lords didn't know what they had to begin with. They knew these things were powerful, but not why. Crack one open, and you'd find a fingerbone, or a knot of old hair. Strong stuff. Smells awful. Ask me how I know, heh. I been holdin' on to 'em, but… I figured you might want 'em.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Mmm. Why?

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: I thought to myself… "You know who might like something strange and unsettling? Eris Morn."

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: A gift, then?

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Well… yeah, Moondust. You could call it a gift.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The sentiment is appreciated… but no. You know what you possess. These relics are not simple curiosities to be hoarded. They might serve a greater purpose.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: And what's that?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Am I your conscience? Discover this for yourself. They are reliquaries, objects of great power. The Darkness moves just beneath its skin. Do you feel it? It ruptures. Flows. Envelops.

lines.speaker: The Drifter
lines.text: Ooh! I like listenin' to you talk.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: And I enjoy your silence.

title: Stealing Stasis — Transcript

lines.text: by Eruke
Stealing Stasis
Kell's Rising, Europa
The Guardian arrives in Riis-Reborn in search of the Fallen's Stasis weapon prototype.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Drifter sent instructions for infiltrating the city. He said he couldn't be on radio — some "top secret" business with Eris and the Stranger. He asked me to fill in for him, but he doesn't think I'll be able to "sell it." …He's wrong. [as Drifter] All right. My notes say we got Ether tanks all over this rooftop — the exploding kind. Use 'em to get those guards before they get us. Brother.
The Guardian destroys twenty Ether tanks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [attempt as Drifter] Nice job with those fireworks. Let's keep movin'. [as self] I can't believe he thought I couldn't do this.
The Guardian delves deeper into the city to find the Crux of Darkness and the Fallen weapon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [as Drifter] So… a Stasis-wieldin' gun. Wonder what Moondust and the Stranger would think of that. [as self] Actually, that's a good question. Do you think Drifter even told them about this? [as Drifter] Too late now, I guess.
The Guardian navigates traps and combatants to reach the Crux of Darkness and steal the Stasis weapon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [attempting Drifter impression] The Fallen have this gun on lockdown. Max security. Stay on your toes. You don't get as old as me by bein' sloppy. [as self] No, no, too wordy… [as Drifter] Don't get sloppy. [as self] Better.
Riis-Reborn Approach, Europa

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [aspiring Drifter impression] Keep one hand on your gun, kid.
The Guardian approaches the Crux of Darkness and the Stasis weapon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [attempt as Drifter] There's the gun. I got access codes to take down that shield. Let me do my magic, brother.
The Guardian hacks the Fallen tech and brings down the shields around the Stasis weapon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [as Drifter] One more. Keep pushin'.
The Guardian removes the weapon's shield.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [as Drifter] Shield's down. Nab that gun, brother.
The Guardian steals the Stasis weapon.
Salvation's Grip

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ah — we tripped an alarm! We gotta, uh — [as Drifter] hightail it outta here — [as self] Ugh, I need to focus! Let's get out of here, Guardian.
The Guardian fights through House Salvation forces and escapes the Fallen city with the stolen weapon.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Hello, old friend. The Drifter said you might need a hand. My associates will arrive shortly. There's a little… roadblock up ahead.
Eventide Ruins, Europa
The Guardian reaches Eventide Ruins as House Salvation activates a barrier preventing the Guardian from escaping. Multiple Brigs appear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Of course…
The Guardian destroys a Fallen Brig. The Spider's associates arrive and deploy Heavy Ammo crates.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: A present from the Shore. I know you Guardians always enjoy a little extra firepower.
The Guardian destroys all Brigs and shield generators in the area. Fallen Commodore appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Another Brig. That thing must be controlling the shield.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen Commodore.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right, we're clear. Uh… thanks for the help, Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Oh, it was nothing. I've heard a little of your exploits with this new power… "Stasis." Consider this a reminder: you have friends on the Shore. Don't be a "stranger," Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not to dwell on this, but… my Drifter impression was pretty good, huh? Listen… [aspiring Drifter impression] "Hive! Bring a sword." See? [as self] Heh. Watch out, Drifter. There's a new Drifter in town.
